what: The generated integration-test module pom declares hu.blackbelt.osgi.i18n:i18n-api with an empty version element, so the module cannot build. kb search for the integration-test module did not return this, and the catalog does not document the empty version.

what: The generated admin UI never sends __version, so two admins editing the same product silently overwrite each other (stock 11 became 7). Optimistic locking does not protect UI edits.
heading: ## Optimistic Locking and `__version`
upstream: Generator defect: the generated TypeScript REST client copies __version only when its runtime type is string (common/utils.ts.hbs:15), but the server sends a number. The version is dropped at load, so a save omits it and optimistic locking is off (browser test: stock 11 overwritten to 7). Expected: copy numeric versions too. The catalog documents the defect and the workaround (send __version explicitly, platform-behavior-reference.md:32). The batch's proposed platform ticket stands; no catalog change is needed.

what: The relation proxy (TableProxyProps) carries no refreshCounter, so a card list inside a view cannot refresh after a row action; the builder reloads its own list after delete and remove.

what: Adding a ShopInfo access to the anonymous Guest actor fails validate in the transform work with 'Zeta validation result mismatch' (ObjectExpressionMatchesBinding). The free-shipping banner is therefore not shown to guests.
heading: ## Validation entry points
proposed: A validate run can fail with 'Zeta validation result mismatch' and list an unexpected error such as ObjectExpressionMatchesBinding, while the EVL checks report no error. The message names no element. The rule means a reference that refers to a collection is assigned an expression that yields a single object. Check the last change first, then compare with a working element of the same kind. If the model is valid, report a validator mismatch; do not work around it by dropping the feature without recording it.
evidence: judo-ng:target/judo-ng-read/wt/models__judo-meta-expression/model/src/main/java/hu/blackbelt/judo/meta/expression/validation/ExpressionZetaValidator.java:263 | judo-ng:models__judo-meta-expression/model/src/main/epsilon/validations/expression/referenceBinding.evl:16-20 | session:L10598-L10605 | kb:kb_search finds no section for the message (catalog gap)
upstream: Validator mismatch: the ASM expression validation (Zeta run, ExpressionZetaValidator.java:263) reports ObjectExpressionMatchesBinding that the EVL run (referenceBinding.evl) does not report, so the transform stops with 'Zeta validation result mismatch' and no element name. Expected: both runs agree, and the mismatch names the element. Reproduction in the session: an object-valued access 'shop' (ShopConfig!any(), ShopInfo target) added to an anonymous actor fails validate; the same expression on an authenticated actor validates (session L10598-L10605). Not re-run with the CLI here: the Sandbox fixture does not contain this case, so the transcript is the only reproduction.
